instructions:
1. Kneel or stand on the assist pad of the machine and grip the handles with an overhand grip just wider than shoulder-width.
2. Hang with your arms fully extended and your shoulders engaged.
3. Pull your body up until your chin clears the bar.
4. Lower your body under control until your arms are fully extended.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Drive your elbows down and back toward your hips to lead with the lats.
2. Set the assistance so you can complete clean reps with full range.
3. Exhale as you pull up and inhale as you lower.
4. Keep your core braced to stop your body from swinging.
name: Assisted pull up normal grip

instructions:
1. Kneel or stand on the assist pad of the machine and grip the handles with an overhand grip wider than shoulder-width.
2. Hang with your arms fully extended and your shoulders engaged.
3. Pull your body up until your chin clears the bar.
4. Lower your body under control until your arms are fully extended.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Pull your elbows down toward your sides to target the outer lats.
2. Set the assistance so you can complete clean reps with full range.
3. Exhale as you pull up and inhale as you lower.
4. Keep your chest up and avoid shrugging your shoulders.
name: Assisted pull up wide grip

instructions:
1. Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
2. Have a partner hold your feet down for stability.
3. Cross your arms over your chest or place your hands by your ears.
4. Curl your upper body up toward your knees.
5. Lower your upper body back down under control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Exhale as you sit up and inhale as you lower.
2. Move with control instead of using momentum.
3. Do not pull on your neck with your hands.
4. Keep your lower back rounding off the floor as you rise.
name: Assisted sit ups

instructions:
1. Stand next to a wall or sturdy support and hold it for balance.
2. Keep your torso upright and your supporting leg slightly bent.
3. Swing your right leg forward and backward in a smooth, controlled motion.
4. Complete your swings, then switch to your left leg.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep the swings controlled and avoid throwing the leg with momentum.
2. Stay tall and do not lean forward or back.
3. Increase the range gradually as the hip loosens.
4. Keep your core engaged to protect your lower back.
name: Back and forward leg swings

instructions:
1. Sit or stand tall with your back straight.
2. Raise your right arm overhead and bend the elbow so your hand drops behind your back.
3. Use your left hand to gently pull the right elbow toward your head.
4. Hold the stretch.
5. Switch arms and repeat.
tips:
1. Pull gently; the stretch should feel mild, not painful.
2. Keep your core engaged to stay upright.
3. Breathe slowly and deeply to relax into the stretch.
4. Keep your shoulders down and avoid shrugging.
name: Back and shoulder stretch
